architecture.code_decoder: round_fmaf(uint8_code, per_output_float32_code_scale, per_output_float32_code_zero_point), then 6-bit windows at shifts 9,6,3,0, centered by 32
architecture.encoder_status: paper-derived deterministic min/max Code-Cluster encoder; official FastDeploy commit publishes loading and dequantization but no offline CCQ encoder
architecture.local_scale: one uint4 multiplier per 64 weights, two multipliers packed per uint8, times one per-output canonical FP16 super-scale
architecture.name: CCQ-RMSE-S0-v0
architecture.vector_group: four consecutive K-axis weights in released KxN orientation

claim_boundary: A kill applies only to this frozen paper-derived CCQ Code-Cluster cell. A promotion is a held-out first-stage plus ideal Gaussian-residual feasibility signal, not an official CCQ reproduction, a finite residual codec, fresh-validation evidence, model-wide generalization, or target achievement.

containment.additive_vq: distinct: one structured overlapping-window code, not a sum of independently indexed codewords
containment.bitplane_context: distinct: fixed-width independent bytes with arithmetic bit extraction, not entropy-coded causal label contexts
containment.direct_output_vq: the materialized per-channel 256x4 table is constrained VQ, but it is channel-conditioned and generated from two floats; the tested local direct-output VQ used one shared 32768x8 stored table and does not contain it at matched side cost
containment.polaris_strata: distinct: independent four-weight VQ-like groups without RHT, long sequential polar/trellis decisions, or arithmetic streams
containment.qsb: distinct: deterministic nearest structured symbols, not stochastic channel simulation, shared randomness, or a multiplicative binary-feature decoder

execution.strict_early_kill: during held-out scoring, accumulated SSE divided by complete held-out source energy is a monotone lower bound; crossing F=0.8 is an exact no-recovery certificate

gaussian_control.matching: each natural 2048-value source row is matched in mean and centered RMS before the identical role orientation and CCQ encoder
gaussian_control.policy: fit and holdout identities, canonical fields, optimization passes, scoring, rate, and read arithmetic are identical

hybrid_rate_kill.why: released weight_only_int2.5 decoder additionally reads one FP16 super-scale per output channel; charging it and framing exceeds the target interval

oracle.definition: canonical finite CCQ first stage followed by an ideal continuous Gaussian residual using every remaining bit at each R
oracle.hard_kill: KILL if held-out pooled q*2^(2*fixed_prefix_bpw)>0.8; the same identity applies at every listed final R
oracle.promote: PROMOTE only if pooled and both expert F values are <=0.8, matched source-minus-Gaussian s is positive, and pooled s is at least 0.18096404744368115
